title: Persistence risks: Use Zustand persist with a strict partialize allowlist and controlled hydration; localStorage is user-readable and must never become a secret store.
description: A complete Zustand 5 state-boundaries lesson using actual vanilla stores, targeted subscriptions and safe client state ownership, including a red starter and offline regression tests.
objectives: Use Zustand persist with a strict partialize allowlist and controlled hydration; localStorage is user-readable and must never become a secret store.
Repair the zustand-persist-private intentionally broken Zustand 5 starter.
Explain what belongs in local, URL or authoritative remote data state.
rubric: I can explain the state ownership principle for persistence risks.
I can repair the 09.04.03 defect using actual Zustand 5 APIs.
I can identify persistence, privacy and hydration risks needing integration tests.
